description.text: Four ways meet at a leaning waymarker stone, and at this hour all four of them are empty. The stone's carved arms are worn past reading; someone has left a lantern hook screwed into the top of it, and no lantern.

Four ways meet at a leaning waymarker stone, its carved arms worn past reading: the hill path behind you, the shepherd's track climbing west, the road south into the village, and the ridge road east — deep-rutted, going nowhere anyone here has been.

options.text: Take the road down into the village
Talk to Alder and his handcart
